visual_approval.scope: Visual baseline only: character, source palette, approximately 180 mm scale and chosen grid feel

attribution.creator: martinwoodward/octoprints contributors
attribution.changes: Uniform rescaling, grid discretization, merged individual bricks, custom joints and preview media.
attribution.endorsement: Independent noncommercial adaptation; no GitHub or LEGO sponsorship implied.

source.color_method: 3MF uniform paint slots decoded exactly; subdivided paint triangles assigned nearest uniformly painted triangle color, then nearest surface color sampled on each boundary grid cell. Interior uses base filament.
source.modified: Source print orientation retained, build-plate translation removed, uniformly scaled to 180 mm, then discretized into separate bonded bricks.

metrics.build_effort_method: Estimate only: 8-16 seconds per part plus 18-48 minutes sorting.

assembly.insertion_scope: Exact lattice occupancy at each step; axis-aligned body/connector geometry must stay inside those XY cell columns. Final joint-profile fit is checked separately in native CAD. No hand/tool clearance, deformation, printed dimensional variation or retention is certified.

independent_order_check.scope: Ordered occupied-cell columns + declared cradle contacts; native geometry/profile and printed performance are separate gates

support_risk.scope: Native BRep volume/COM, individual self-weight projection onto an inscribed 24-sided bearing-patch hull. NOT transferred upper-layer loads, real infill mass, shock, friction or retention.

warnings: 外観基準のみ選択済み。接合部・組立は試作であり、実機嵌合・保持力・製造リリースは未承認です。
名目挿入経路は占有セルと鉛直方向で検査。手・工具・変形・印刷誤差を含む組立保証ではありません。
隠れた着座パッドで面の接触を用意していますが、正のクリアランスだけでは抜け止めを保証しません。
最初は選択ピッチの小型試験セットのみ。全体の部品を印刷しないでください。印刷時間・質量・スライス結果は未確認です。
部品単体の自重投影による片持ち条件 87 個、丸スタッド1本の条件 515 個。上層からの荷重・衝撃・保持力は未検証です。

appearance_preservation.scope: Exact voxel envelope/palette preserved; grouping seams can move. Not a claim of pixel-identical continuous exterior geometry.

source_binding.geometry_note: FreeCAD, Blender and browser consume identical type meshes/IDs/rigid transforms
